analysis: The code snippet iterates over Map.Entry sets of two maps (fields and fieldsNot) using explicit iterators. It calls entry.getValue() for each entry. No modification (removal) of entries is performed during iteration. The maps are not modified concurrently. Therefore, the condition for IllegalStateException (entry removed from backing map) does not occur. The exception is fully avoided.
remark: No exceptions are thrown because no entry removal occurs. The getValue method's javadoc specifies that IllegalStateException may be thrown if the entry has been removed, but this never happens in the given code.
